notes.title: An Update on the Game's State
notes.content:
Hello Pilots, Someguy's here to address the current state of the game.

First, I would like to apologize for the lack of communication between us and the players. Personal life has kept all of us busy, but this is no excuse to leave those participating in the Early Access demo in the dark. We will make better efforts in the future to communicate with everyone.

As for the game, we are currently working on the soundtrack for Stage 5. All that's left are 4 more tracks and a couple more assets before the game is ready to launch for version 1.0.

Additionally, we are working on a new mode for Assault Shell 2 called "Mission Mode" where you will be challenged with clearing a set of challenges to win bonus rewards such as data points and more. We will be rolling out with an update soon once this mode is completed, however we may or may not withhold the release of this mode until the full game is completed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417730/ff0ba6fd31afe63160c1ffe77f696f7acf012036.png[/img]

Finally, we plan to add Steam Achievements, Steam Trading Cards, and a Steam Leaderboard in the final version of the game.

Thank you all for your continued support. Look forward to finishing the fight once and for all!

-Someguy

notes.title: Major Update!: Version 0.9.2
notes.content:
New Stage Added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44417730/d424ddc5a5b568881a696b81959c9ff0f99186a0.png[/img]
- Added Stage 4 to the game
- Stage 4 is now accessible in practice mode.

Adjustments
- Reduced the amount needed to buy alt colors to 1000 data per color.
- Reduced the increment for buying credits from 1000 increase to a 500 increase.
- Added a function where some bosses give off small amounts of hyper energy when reaching a certain HP threshold.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where Rouge Delta wouldn't leave it's temporary speed/invul mode when using it's special weapon, keeping the color blue and increased ship speed.
- Fixed alt colors not displaying properly when the ship spawns/during cutscenes.
- Fixed a bug where the continue screen wouldn't show if the player ship is destroyed.

notes.title: Small Update: Version 0.9.1.1
notes.content:
